Future<void> work() async {
  final list = [for (final item in await items()) item.id];
  final map = {for (final item in await items()) item.id: item};
  for (final item in await items()) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await read(item);
  }
}

class Batches {
  static const width = 4;
  static const one = 1;

  Future<void> work(items) async {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += width) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += one) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
    }
  }
}
